svg.title: AkiDB TextSearch workflow
svg.desc: TextSearch authenticates the caller, plans a retrieval mode, recalls with CPU HNSW and BM25, fuses and filters, optionally expands the graph and reranks, then returns top-k or ContextPackV1.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TextSearch workflow

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The agent call. pack=true returns ContextPackV1 from this same path.

svg.text: Search in-process BM25. retrieval_mode=bm25 skips the embedding call.
